lines.text: This incandescent first book from a lifelong Chicagoan and Neofuturist alum is easily the best thing I've read this year. "A messy object of many genres" reaching for a kind of truth, this singular book has a bit of everything, but not a word is out of place. Maybe you're looking for something that will make you excited again about the possibilities of language. This book is it.
